question: Rank supplier nations by total 1998 profit from line items of parts named like '%green%'. Profit = l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity. Which nation is first?

text: Two matching queries are already running. I'll run the first one verbatim, since it matches the question's filters.

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name

text: Two identical-purpose queries are already running from other analysts. I'll run the second one verbatim so I get its result without recomputing it.

sql:
SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS profit
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1998
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY profit DESC

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS profit
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1998
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY profit DESC

answer: SAUDI ARABIA is first, with total 1998 profit of about 279,378,137.20 from line items for parts whose name matches '%green%'. KENYA is second (278,319,101.13). The ranking covers 25 supplier nations, grouped by supplier nation and filtered on order date in 1998.
